name: Eating Healthy
overview: Scripture reveals that God originally provided humanity with plants and fruits for nourishment, as seen in Genesis 1:29, and later expanded this provision to include animals after the flood (Genesis 9:3). The Mosaic Law further instructs the Israelites to abstain from consuming fat and blood, emphasizing holiness and obedience in their eating habits (Leviticus 3:17; 7:23). Wisdom literature also warns against overindulgence, urging self-control in appetite (Proverbs 23:2), highlighting that healthy eating is not only about what we consume but also how we govern our desires.
